theme: One clear day before the week tightens.
greeting: Good afternoon, Dan. The calendar is open end to end, which almost never happens four days out from Croatia. Marc has looped back on the Nomura idea and the reply is yours now, and the pre-trip bookings are the one thing with a real clock on them.

needsAttention.title: Marc is back on the Nomura project
needsAttention.detail: In the Valoris thread, Marc Lubrano circled back this afternoon after your note wanting a call on the books, and floats proposing "a real project for Nomura" while doubting Chie has the budget. The next move is yours.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Sept 19 Cavtat night before you fly
needsAttention.detail: The last Dubrovnik-side night and its noon marina transfer have to be booked from land before the Sept 8 departure, since charter connectivity won't let you do it aboard. It has been an open P1 since late August.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Croatia bags are actually ticketed
needsAttention.detail: The issued Basic Economy fare shows zero checked bags. Verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site and buy online before counter rates, because two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on.

flagged.title: A sitter applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Carly M. applied to the job you posted, worth a glance when you line up help around the trip.

inbox.noise: Everything else is Labor Day promos, industry newsletters, and campaign mail.

resolved.title: Kehoe PRI call was canceled
resolved.detail: Conor Kehoe's office canceled today's 10 AM EDT Zoom on PRI sustainability and stewardship, so it is off your plate with nothing to reschedule unless you want to.

recipe.title: Roasted kabocha squash
recipe.why: Autumn brings the first hard squashes into season, sweet and ready for a hot oven.

tasks.title: Book the St Pete landing-gap nights (Sept 20-21)
Book a refundable backup SUV, Sept 20 to Oct 5
Build and pack the travel larder bin
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: The calendar is empty end to end, a genuinely open day and a rare one this close to a departure.
Nothing is booked to pull you anywhere, so the hours bend to whatever you point them at.
One of the last St Pete evenings with the girls home before the boat, and nothing on the books.
